title: COMPARATIVE EVALUATION OF TECHNOLOGIES FOR FORMING ANTICORROSION COATINGS ON AUSTENITIC STAINLESS STEELS FOR ENERGY EQUIPMENT BASED ON OPERATIONAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL CRITERIA
authors: Nadiia Kanunnikova, Alona Bosiuk, Valentyna Voloshchuk, Albert Dzhamirzoiev, Yehor Lehenkyi
abstract: The paper systematizes and comparatively analyzes modern technologies for forming anticorrosion coatings on austenitic stainless steels used in energy equipment. The technologies considered include electrodeposition, laser cladding, high-velocity oxy-fuel spraying, cold spray, diffusion aluminizing, physical vapor deposition, atomic layer deposition, and sol-gel processing. The comparison is based on interconnected operational, structural, and environmental criteria, including the nature of the coating/substrate interface, defectiveness and phase composition, mechanisms of protective oxide formation, stability under corrosive and thermal loading, and material and energy flows associated with coating production. Based on the results of the generalization, a functional classification of protective coatings was proposed according to the dominant factor of loss of protective ability, which allowed us to distinguish defect-controlled, porosity-controlled, diffusion-reserve, metallurgically bound, and reaction-converted systems. It is shown that coating thickness cannot be used as a universal measure of protective efficiency. For electrodeposited systems, composition, dispersion state, and defect structure are critical; for laser-clad coatings, metallurgical bonding and thermal stability dominate; for HVOF and cold-sprayed coatings, density, interparticle bonding, and residual porosity are decisive; for diffusion aluminide systems, long-term performance is controlled by the available Al reservoir and its depletion kinetics; and for PVD and ALD coatings, the integrity of the thin barrier layer is essential. Environmentally significant flows differ substantially among the technologies. Electrodeposition involves electrolytes, rinse water, and metal-containing wastewater; thermal and kinetic spraying processes consume powders and process gases; laser and vacuum methods are associated with energy consumption, process gases, and specialized materials; and diffusion processes require prolonged high-temperature treatment. The analysis shows that technologies should not be formally ranked by environmental performance without a common functional unit and consistent life-cycle boundaries. Promising directions include controlling coating defectiveness and phase stability, applying non-stationary electrodeposition modes, developing multicomponent metal-oxide systems, increasing material utilization efficiency, and partially closing material and wastewater loops.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection for austenitic stainless-steel energy equipment should match interface integrity, defect structure, and protective-element reserves to expected corrosion and thermal loads.

zh-Hans.title: 基于服役与环境准则的能源设备用奥氏体不锈钢防腐涂层制备技术比较评价
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文系统梳理并比较分析了能源设备用奥氏体不锈钢防腐涂层的现代制备技术。所考察的技术包括电沉积、激光熔覆、超音速火焰喷涂、冷喷涂、扩散渗铝、物理气相沉积、原子层沉积和溶胶–凝胶法。比较依据为相互关联的服役、结构及环境准则，包括涂层/基体界面的性质、缺陷状况与相组成、保护性氧化物的形成机制、腐蚀与热载荷下的稳定性，以及涂层生产相关的物料流和能量流。基于归纳结果，提出了按防护能力丧失的主导因素划分防护涂层的功能分类方法，将其区分为缺陷控制型、孔隙率控制型、扩散储备型、冶金结合型和反应转化型体系。研究表明，涂层厚度不能作为防护效能的通用衡量指标。对于电沉积体系，成分、分散状态和缺陷结构至关重要；对于激光熔覆涂层，冶金结合和热稳定性起主导作用；对于HVOF和冷喷涂涂层，致密度、颗粒间结合和残余孔隙率具有决定性作用；对于扩散铝化物体系，长期性能受可用Al储量及其耗竭动力学控制；对于PVD和ALD涂层，薄阻挡层的完整性至关重要。各技术涉及的具有环境影响的物料流和能量流存在显著差异。电沉积涉及电解液、漂洗水和含金属废水；热喷涂和动能喷涂工艺消耗粉末及工艺气体；激光和真空方法涉及能源消耗、工艺气体及专用材料；扩散工艺则需要长时间高温处理。分析表明，在缺乏共同功能单位和一致生命周期边界的情况下，不应对各技术的环境绩效作正式排名。有前景的方向包括控制涂层缺陷状况和相稳定性、采用非稳态电沉积模式、开发多组分金属–氧化物体系、提高材料利用效率，以及实现物料和废水的部分闭路循环。

title: Non-Destructive Evaluation for Engineered Surfaces: Methods, In-Process Sensing, and Data-Driven Inspection in the NDE 4.0 Era
authors: Kuldeep Sharma, R. P. Sharma
abstract: Engineered surfaces such as coatings, diffusion layers, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, additively manufactured surface regions, peened layers, and anodised films increasingly determine the performance, inspect ability, and service life of high-value metallic and ceramic components. Wear, corrosion, fatigue, oxidation, debonding, and crack initiation are controlled in these shallow, graded, anisotropic, and interface- dominated regions. This review examines how non-destructive evaluation (NDE) methods can be selected and qualified for them. It links inspection physics to specific problems: coating thickness and adhesion, near- surface residual stress, porosity gradients, lack of fusion, thermal-barrier-coating debonding, weak cold-spray interfaces, and additive-manufacturing surface roughness. Magnetic Barkhausen noise, eddy-current testing, active infrared thermography, phased-array and laser ultrasonics, acoustic emission, optical metrology, digital image correlation, microwave and terahertz sensing, and X-ray computed tomography are assessed for both capability and limitation. The review argues for hierarchical, multi-modal strategies in which rapid screening is followed by calibrated confirmation where required. It also covers the shift toward NDE 4.0, including in- process sensing, data fusion, physics-informed machine learning, uncertainty-aware interpretation, and digital twins. Persistent barriers include limited probability-of-detection evidence, poor transferability of data-driven models, scarce reference specimens, and incomplete acceptance criteria
venue: South Mediterranean University Journal of Pure and Applied Sciences

zh-Hans.title: 工程化表面的无损评价：NDE 4.0 时代的方法、过程传感与数据驱动检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 涂层、扩散层、冷喷涂沉积层、激光熔覆层、增材制造表面区域、喷丸强化层和阳极氧化膜等工程化表面，日益决定着高价值金属和陶瓷部件的性能、可检测性与服役寿命。磨损、腐蚀、疲劳、氧化、脱粘和裂纹萌生受这些浅表、梯度分布、各向异性且以界面效应为主导的区域控制。本综述探讨如何针对这些区域选择无损评价（NDE）方法并开展适用性鉴定，将检测的物理原理与具体问题联系起来，包括涂层厚度与附着力、近表面残余应力、孔隙率梯度、未熔合、热障涂层脱粘、冷喷涂界面结合薄弱以及增材制造表面粗糙度。综述评估了磁巴克豪森噪声、涡流检测、主动红外热成像、相控阵超声与激光超声、声发射、光学计量、数字图像相关、微波与太赫兹传感以及 X 射线计算机断层成像的能力与局限性。综述主张采用分层、多模态策略，即先进行快速筛查，再在必要时采用经校准的方法进行确认。综述还涵盖了向 NDE 4.0 的转型，包括过程传感、数据融合、物理信息机器学习、考虑不确定性的结果解读以及数字孪生。持续存在的障碍包括检出概率证据有限、数据驱动模型的可迁移性差、参考试样稀缺以及验收准则不完善。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The approach supports process-window selection for robust HDPE joints by predicting thermal responses, axial forces and defect formation.

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种有效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究综合采用计算与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、竖直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行预测，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度及底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，其在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面表现出很高的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度，并抑制竖直方向的力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值压入力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊缝区域形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，标示存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C预热条件下获得了最优工况，而在1000 rpm且未预热时，由于形成虫洞缺陷，焊接性较差。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指导，并展示了计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and chloride-corrosion resistance, or 80Ni20Cr for erosion under the tested conditions.

zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在 Al 6061-T6 合金基体上沉积了 80Ni20Cr 和 NiCrAlY 两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用 SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量和冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS 结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与 80Ni20Cr 相比，NiCrAlY 涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD 在 80Ni20Cr 中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的 CrNi 相，在 NiCrAlY 中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的 Al₂NiY 相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶粒结构。AFM 测量表明，NiCrAlY 的表面粗糙度在全部三个样品中最低。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY 的硬度约为 80Ni20Cr 的 10 倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY 的硬度为 7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr 的硬度为 780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的 Al 6061 基体的硬度为 708.68 MPa。在 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY 的腐蚀电流密度最低，为 6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr 涂层的腐蚀电流密度为 1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为 0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的 0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY 具有超疏水性，而 80Ni20Cr 接近超疏水状态。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr 的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的 3.5 wt% NaCl 溶液；冲击角为 90°、速度为 40 m/s、持续时间为 5 min 的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY 表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而 80Ni20Cr 表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: Automatic extraction of welding trajectories for V-groove welds based on 3-D active vision imaging
authors: Jingjing Lou, Yuanhan Li, Liangliang Sun, Chuan Ye, Yuancheng Zhu
abstract: Abstract To automatically extract welding trajectories for planar welds on reflective materials, this paper proposes a three-dimensional active vision-based welding trajectory extraction methodology that is based on the fusion of features. First, to accurately segment the laser stripes at the weld seam, a saliency feature fusion-based laser stripe segmentation model (SFF_LSM) has been developed. The SFF_LSM model effectively suppresses background interference features, accurately segmenting the general features of the laser stripe distribution along the weld seam. Next, the gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing is employed to extract the center of the laser stripe. Finally, the point cloud data at the weld seam is filtered, and the least squares fitting algorithm is employed to extract the welding trajectory automatically. The results of the experiment demonstrate that the proposed method is an effective means of overcoming the interference caused by reflections, with the maximum fitting errors of the weld seam welding trajectory being 0.51 mm in the X direction, 0.40 mm in the Y direction, and 0.29 mm in the Z direction.

infographic.key_insight: Feature-fused 3-D active vision automatically extracts V-groove welding trajectories on reflective materials while suppressing reflection interference.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The method supports automated weld-path generation where reflective surfaces complicate laser-based seam detection.
method: Segment weld-seam laser stripes using the saliency feature fusion model SFF_LSM.
Extract stripe centers using a gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing.
Filter seam point clouds and fit welding trajectories using least squares.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract addresses planar welds; performance on nonplanar seams or under different reflection conditions remains unestablished.

zh-Hans.title: 基于三维主动视觉成像的V形坡口焊缝焊接轨迹自动提取
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 为自动提取反光材料上平面焊缝的焊接轨迹，本文提出了一种基于特征融合的三维主动视觉焊接轨迹提取方法。首先，为准确分割焊缝处的激光条纹，开发了基于显著性特征融合的激光条纹分割模型（SFF_LSM）。SFF_LSM模型能够有效抑制背景干扰特征，准确分割沿焊缝分布的激光条纹的整体特征。随后，采用带二次平滑的灰度重心算法提取激光条纹中心。最后，对焊缝处的点云数据进行滤波，并采用最小二乘拟合算法自动提取焊接轨迹。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够有效克服反光造成的干扰，焊缝焊接轨迹在X方向、Y方向和Z方向的最大拟合误差分别为0.51 mm、0.40 mm和0.29 mm。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best combined wear and corrosion performance, while HVOF produced the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, HVAF is a promising process choice when both sliding wear and corrosion resistance matter.

Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction, volumetric wear rate and corrosion behavior.
Examine wear marks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速火焰喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的微观组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速火焰喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 V_SCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层具有最佳的耐磨与耐腐蚀综合性能，而HVOF制备的涂层硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于304不锈钢上的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，当需要兼顾滑动磨损抗力和耐腐蚀性时，HVAF是一种有前景的工艺选择。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较微观组织、维氏硬度、摩擦、体积磨损率和腐蚀行为。
检查磨痕，以识别磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF涂层的磨损率为(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而未涂覆不锈钢的磨损率为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)；HVAF涂层的耐腐蚀性排名最高，腐蚀电流密度为(1.75±0.02) μA/cm²。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings could improve boiler-steel oxidation resistance by forming dense protective oxides with lower porosity and higher microhardness.
method: Apply Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conduct 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterize microstructure and phases using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: Laboratory testing identified HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC as the best-performing coating, while bare steel developed extensive oxide spalling and cracking.
infographic.watch_item: Performance over 50 laboratory air-oxidation cycles does not establish long-term durability under actual boiler combustion, erosion, and corrosion conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF和等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在模拟实验室环境中，于900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）及X射线元素面分布分析，研究试验后的微观组织与物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe2O3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层相较于裸露SA516钢将最大增重降低了95.71%，表现出优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power governs penetration and keyhole growth, welding speed reduces weld dimensions, and current strengthens convection and arc stability.

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

title: Evaluation of Induction Thermography for the Detection of Cracks Due to Mechanical and Thermal Stress in WC-10Co-4Cr Coatings
authors: Niklas Steinbrecher, A. Meier, Hans Jürgen Maier, Manuel Rodriguez Diaz, Kai Möhwald, Sebastian Barton
abstract: Abstract WC–Co-Cr coatings have exceptional mechanical properties including high hardness, wear resistance and corrosion resistance. However, under continuous wear or mechanical/thermal overloads, such as line loads in calender rollers or improper heating/cooling cycles, these coatings can develop defects like cracks and dents. Such damage compromises product quality, particularly in calendering processes where precise roller concentricity (single-figure micrometre range) is critical. This study investigates induction thermography as a non-destructive alternative for defect detection in WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Coated C60 steel specimens with different surface roughness (conditions: ground and as-sprayed) were subjected to controlled mechanical (strains: 0.12% to 0.4%) and thermal stresses (thermal shock), inducing cracks with widths ranging from approx. 1 to 4.5 µm and depths up to the full coating thickness (≈ 400 µm). Both crack width and depth influenced the thermal contrast, with deeper cracks producing a stronger signal. Using the Fourier transform method and principal component analysis, induction thermography successfully identified cracks down to a minimum resolved width of ≈ 1 µm in ground and ≈ 1.7 µm in as-sprayed specimens, demonstrating its sensitivity to defect detection across different surface conditions. The results highlight the potential of this method to improve process reliability and product quality in high-precision applications by enabling non-invasive inspection.

zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 WC–Co-Cr 涂层具有优异的力学性能，包括高硬度、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。然而，在持续磨损或机械/热过载条件下，例如压延辊承受线载荷或经历不当的加热/冷却循环时，这些涂层可能产生裂纹和凹痕等缺陷。此类损伤会损害产品质量，尤其是在对辊筒同心度要求严格（个位数微米范围）的压延工艺中。本研究探讨了将感应热成像作为一种无损检测方法，用于检测 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层中的缺陷。对具有不同表面粗糙度（磨削态和喷涂态）的涂覆 C60 钢试样施加受控的机械应力（应变：0.12% 至 0.4%）和热应力（热冲击），诱发宽度约为 1 至 4.5 µm、深度最大可贯穿整个涂层厚度（≈ 400 µm）的裂纹。裂纹宽度和深度均影响热对比度，其中较深的裂纹产生更强的信号。采用傅里叶变换法和主成分分析，感应热成像成功识别了磨削态试样中最小可分辨宽度为 ≈ 1 µm、喷涂态试样中最小可分辨宽度为 ≈ 1.7 µm 的裂纹，表明其在不同表面状态下均具有缺陷检测灵敏度。结果凸显了该方法通过非侵入式检测提高高精度应用中工艺可靠性和产品质量的潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 感应热成像在无需破坏性测试的情况下，检测到了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层中的微米级裂纹。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 非侵入式裂纹检测有望提高精密压延辊的可靠性和产品质量，因为涂层损伤会威胁其微米级同心度。
method: 测试 C60 钢上的磨削态和喷涂态 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。
通过施加 0.12–0.4% 的机械应变和热冲击诱发裂纹。
使用傅里叶变换和主成分分析处理感应热成像信号。
infographic.evidence_signal: 磨削表面上的最小可分辨裂纹宽度约为 1 µm，喷涂态表面上约为 1.7 µm；较深的裂纹产生了更强的热对比度。
infographic.watch_item: 检测灵敏度取决于表面状态和裂纹几何形态；这些试样的结果尚不能确定该方法在全尺寸辊筒上的性能。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

infographic.key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings associated with acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a starting point for process qualification: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Two-level full factorial DOE reported with 24 experimental runs.
ANOVA quantified spray-parameter contributions to coating responses.
Pareto charts assessed parameter interaction effects.

infographic.watch_item: Verify the DOE structure and replication before reuse: the reported 24 runs are not explained for a four-factor, two-level full factorial design.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF喷涂参数对Ti6Al4V基体上Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr)涂层质量特性的影响研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 对喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）参数进行系统优化，需要开展大量实验，以确定使涂层质量最优的条件。本研究采用比传统单因素逐次试验（OFAT）方法更稳健、更高效的全因子设计（FFD），研究HVOF喷涂参数对沉积在Ti6Al4V基体上的Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的影响。采用包含24次试验的FFD实验设计（DOE）方法，在两个水平上评估所有输入因素。每次试验均测量涂层的响应特性。采用方差分析（ANOVA）量化各喷涂参数对输出响应的贡献。对于这一基体与涂层组合，喷涂距离、送粉速率和燃气流量等喷涂参数之间的交互作用对涂层性能的影响鲜有报道。因此，还采用帕累托图分析喷涂参数对涂层性能的交互作用效应。最终，当喷涂参数中的喷涂距离、送粉速率、氢气流量和氧气流量分别为150 mm、25 g/min、475 NLPM和205 NLPM时，获得了硬度、孔隙率和氧化物等方面可接受的质量特性。

infographic.key_insight: 因子分析确定了与Ti6Al4V基体上Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr)涂层的可接受硬度、孔隙率及氧化物特性相关的HVOF参数设置。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin combines weld-pool simulation and Gaussian-process surrogates to screen robotic welding conditions and control strategies for future in-space metal joining.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Fast surrogate predictions could support welding parameter selection and adaptive control before costly flight-like testing.
method: Finite-volume thermal model includes phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local pressure; gravity is assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates predict solver outputs.

infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-only; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and hardware-in-the-loop validation remain necessary.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低面向太空金属连接的机器人焊接风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着对太空在轨服务、制造与装配的兴趣日益增长，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下运行的特性仍缺乏充分认识，类飞行条件试验也十分有限。由英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化方式降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积热焊接熔池模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界测试案例中，80 个求解器响应有 74 个落在标称 90% GP 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在一项仿真 UR5 L 形焊缝研究中，随着行进速度在拐角附近降低，比例控制器调整焊接电源的一元化设定。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环工况点和 12 个开环工况点中的 9 个均位于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 焊缝根部宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空、针对性的低重力以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估该模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理的数字孪生结合焊接熔池仿真与高斯过程代理模型，为未来太空金属连接筛选机器人焊接条件和控制策略。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 快速代理模型预测有望在昂贵的类飞行条件测试之前，支持焊接参数选择和自适应控制。
method: 有限体积热模型包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力；重力单独评估。

title: Impact Of Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binder systems on the microstructure and functional properties of WC coatings produced by detonation spraying
authors: Zarina Aringozhina, Нуртолеу Магазов, Nazerke Muktanova, Gulzhaz Uazyrkhanova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of metallic binder composition (Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr) on the microstructure and performance characteristics of tungsten carbide-based coatings deposited by detonation spraying. A comprehensive characterization was carried out using scanning electron microscopy, EDS elemental mapping, microhardness testing, tribological evaluation, scratch testing, and electrochemical corrosion analysis. The results demonstrate that binder type significantly affects coating porosity, WC phase distribution, hardness, and tribological behavior. The WC–Co-Cr coating exhibited the most favorable combination of properties: the lowest coefficient of friction (0.515), the highest microhardness (1232.55 HV), the best scratch resistance, and superior corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution. The WC–Ni coating showed the lowest porosity (0.40%) due to the high fluidity of the nickel binder, while WC–NiCr demonstrated the highest porosity (2.78%) and the most pronounced susceptibility to cracking under progressive loading. The findings confirm the strong potential of detonation-sprayed WC–Co-Cr coatings for extending the service life of pipeline valves and other components operating under wear and corrosion conditions in the oil and gas industry.

infographic.engineering_relevance: WC–Co–Cr coatings are promising for pipeline valves and other oil-and-gas components exposed to wear and corrosive environments.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed WC coatings with Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binders.
Characterized microstructure and elemental distribution using SEM and EDS mapping.
Evaluated microhardness, tribology, scratch resistance, and electrochemical corrosion.

infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not establish long-term field durability under combined wear and corrosion, so service-specific validation remains necessary.

zh-Hans.title: Co–Cr、Ni 和 NiCr 粘结相体系对爆炸喷涂 WC 涂层微观组织与功能性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了金属粘结相成分（Co–Cr、Ni 和 NiCr）对爆炸喷涂制备的碳化钨基涂层微观组织与性能特征的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、EDS 元素面分布分析、显微硬度测试、摩擦学评价、划痕测试和电化学腐蚀分析进行了全面表征。结果表明，粘结相类型显著影响涂层孔隙率、WC 相分布、硬度和摩擦学行为。WC–Co-Cr 涂层表现出最优的综合性能：最低的摩擦系数（0.515）、最高的显微硬度（1232.55 HV）、最佳的抗划痕性能，以及在 3.5 wt.% NaCl 溶液中优异的耐腐蚀性能。由于镍粘结相具有较高的流动性，WC–Ni 涂层的孔隙率最低（0.40%）；而 WC–NiCr 涂层的孔隙率最高（2.78%），且在渐增加载下表现出最明显的开裂倾向。研究结果证实，爆炸喷涂 WC–Co-Cr 涂层在延长石油天然气行业中承受磨损和腐蚀的管道阀门及其他部件的使用寿命方面具有很大潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试的爆炸喷涂 WC 涂层中，采用 Co–Cr 粘结相的涂层在硬度、摩擦、抗划痕和耐腐蚀方面表现出最佳的综合性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: WC–Co–Cr 涂层有望应用于暴露在磨损和腐蚀环境中的管道阀门及其他石油天然气行业部件。
method: 比较了采用 Co–Cr、Ni 和 NiCr 粘结相的爆炸喷涂 WC 涂层。
采用 SEM 和 EDS 面分布分析表征微观组织与元素分布。
评估了显微硬度、摩擦学性能、抗划痕性能和电化学腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: WC–Co–Cr 的显微硬度达到 1232.55 HV，摩擦系数为 0.515；WC–Ni 的孔隙率最低（0.40%），WC–NiCr 的孔隙率最高（2.78%）；腐蚀测试采用 3.5 wt.% NaCl 溶液。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings offer better long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces their friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray processing and service humidity should be considered together when designing Fe-based amorphous coatings for corrosion and wear protection of Q235 steel.

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢表面成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展系数，这对于减少涂层缺陷以及形成微观组织致密的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、低孔隙率的铁基非晶涂层具有更好的长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度升高会降低其摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 在设计用于Q235钢腐蚀与磨损防护的铁基非晶涂层时，应综合考虑爆炸喷涂工艺和服役环境湿度。
